provider: ElevenLabs Image & Video API, model creatify-aurora 720p
approval: Kevin 2026-09-19: approved SPEAK take, 'mount it, it was perfect'. Zero generation.

registration.method: phase correlation of gradient images (actor masked out) against frame 0 of assets/astrid-3d/greenscreen/take-dealer-first-card.mp4 (1920x1080, the runtime placement basis); windows leftRail/rightRail/shoe agree at dx 0/-1, dy 15 for scale 1.5; frontRail dy 9 (generative drift, not corrected)
registration.resample: scale=1920:1056 lanczos, pad=1920:1080 at (0,15) with backdrop green 0x196f2d, fps=24 by frame drop (timing kept for lip sync), audio copied

spliceMeasurement.method: phase correlation of head/torso/hand windows, source frame 0 and 115 against the base eye-contact idle frame 0 (the layer shown right before the cut) and the dealer take frame 0; dx/dy in source px
spliceMeasurement.note: Props register at (0,15) (applied in source.mp4). Against the base idle the take still sits higher: head ~20 px, torso ~20 px, hands 6-10 px. That is a pose difference, not a rigid residual, so no further offset is applied; a cut pop of that size remains.

greeting.text: Welcome to Privé Blackjack. Take a seat, I'll be your dealer tonight.

audioMeasurement.method: cross-correlation of the take's embedded AAC track against greeting.mp3 (44.1 kHz mono)

greeting.readyPose: frame 0 and the last frame (both the plate ready pose; hands, shoe and card stationary)

note: Cut in at frame 0 and out at the last frame, both plate ready poses; the recorded line starts on the first presented frame plus audioOffsetSeconds. Speak plays over the held waiting idle; base idle resumes afterwards.
